articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: What happens when an AI agent pays for the wrong thing
articles.snippet: The largest card networks now sit in the top governance tier of x402, the standard that AI agents use to pay for things online. Albert Castellana of GenLayer Labs explains why that standard has no way to dispute a charge, and what happens when the payment settles but the agent receives something wrong or useless.

articles.title: Settlement concerns prompt Euronext to halt CoinShares’ Zcash ETP ahead of debut
articles.snippet: A Euronext spokesperson told Cointelegraph the suspension was due to “operational settlement requirements” and remains in effect until settlement operations are supported by the CSD.

articles.title: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Keystone Pulls Devices as Stolen Key Opens Door to Fakes
articles.snippet: Attackers obtained the factory key that proves Keystone's hardware wallets are genuine, and 25,964 buyer records were affected. The company says recovery phrases and private keys were not involved.

articles.title: OpenAI Proves ETH Is False, and Crypto Twitter Has Questions
articles.snippet: A new OpenAI paper declares ETH false, a claim that hundreds of research papers lean on. Crypto Twitter degens and serious mathematicians are abuzz.

articles.title: Polymarket Has Investigated 'Dozens' of Midterm Election Bets: Report
articles.snippet: The firm's new head of investigations says its surveillance system flags hundreds of alerts a day, with at least two cases sent to the CFTC.
